questions.q: In which year did Slovenia become independent?
questions.why: It left Yugoslavia after a ten-day war.

questions.q: Which short war in 1991 secured Slovenian independence?
questions.why: Few lives were lost.

questions.q: Which empire ruled Slovenian lands for centuries?
questions.why: It lasted until 1918.

questions.q: Which First World War front ran along the Soča River?
questions.why: Twelve battles were fought there.

questions.q: What is the capital of Slovenia?
questions.why: Its name may mean 'beloved'.

questions.q: Which Slavic principality in the 600s–700s is seen as an early Slovene state?
questions.why: It was centred in today's Austria.

questions.q: Which lake has a church on a tiny island?
questions.why: Visitors ring its wishing bell.

questions.q: Which famous cave system with a cave train is in Slovenia?
questions.why: It has a train ride inside.

questions.q: Which mountain is Slovenia's highest and appears on its flag?
questions.why: Its name means 'three heads'.

questions.q: Which sea does Slovenia's short coast face?
questions.why: Its coast is only about 47 km long.

questions.q: Which UNESCO-listed caves have a huge underground canyon?
questions.why: The Reka River flows through them.

questions.q: Which castle is built into a cliff cave?
questions.why: It has stood for over 800 years.

questions.q: Which river valley is famous for its emerald colour?
questions.why: It is popular for rafting.

questions.q: Which ski-jumping hill in Planica set many world records?
questions.why: It is a giant ski-flying hill.

questions.q: Which Slovenian basketball star plays in the NBA?
questions.why: He is one of the league's top scorers.

questions.q: Which Slovenian cyclist has won the Tour de France several times?
questions.why: He rides for UAE Team Emirates.

questions.q: Which Slovenian poet wrote the words of the national anthem?
questions.why: The day of his death, 8 February, is Culture Day.

questions.q: Who printed the first books in Slovene in 1550?
questions.why: He appeared on the old 10-tolar note.

questions.q: Which novel about the Isonzo Front did Hemingway set partly in Kobarid?
questions.why: Kobarid was then called Caporetto.

questions.q: Which writer is seen as the greatest Slovene prose author?
questions.why: He died in 1918.

questions.q: Which architect redesigned much of Ljubljana?
questions.why: He also worked on Prague Castle.

questions.q: In which year did Slovenia join the European Union?
questions.why: It adopted the euro in 2007.

questions.q: Which US First Lady was born in Slovenia?
questions.why: She grew up in Sevnica.

questions.q: Which mathematician born in Slovenia calculated logarithm tables?
questions.why: A crater on the Moon is named after him.

questions.q: Which physicist born in Slovenia gave his name to a law of radiation?
questions.why: It is the Stefan–Boltzmann law.

questions.q: What is Slovenia's currency?
questions.why: It replaced the tolar in 2007.

questions.q: Which famous white horses come from a Slovenian stud farm?
questions.why: Lipica stud was founded in 1580.

questions.q: Which layered cake with poppy seeds, walnuts and apples is a Slovene speciality?
questions.why: It comes from Prekmurje.

questions.q: Which rolled nut cake is served at Christmas and Easter?
questions.why: It is often filled with walnuts.

questions.q: What is the famous cream slice from Bled called?
questions.why: Millions have been sold at the lakeside hotel.
